books.title: Zero to Hero Social Media Manager
books.description: A complete guide to becoming a professional social media manager from scratch. Covers platform setup, content creation, client acquisition, and campaign management.
books.author: SavvyPro Team

chapters.title: The Social Media Landscape
chapters.body: Social media has transformed how businesses connect with customers. In this chapter, we explore the major platforms and how to choose the right ones for your business.

chapters.title: Content Pillars & Planning
chapters.body: Learn to build a content strategy that resonates with your audience. We cover content pillars, posting frequency, and planning tools that keep you consistent.

chapters.title: Community Management
chapters.body: Building an engaged community requires more than just posting content. This chapter covers engagement strategies, moderation, and community growth tactics.

chapters.title: Paid Social Advertising
chapters.body: Take your social media to the next level with paid advertising. We cover Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads setup and optimization.

chapters.title: Analytics & Reporting
chapters.body: Measure what matters. Learn to track key metrics, create reports, and use data to improve your social media strategy over time.

chapters.title: Landing Clients & Pricing
chapters.body: Turn your social media skills into a business. This chapter covers client acquisition, pricing packages, contracts, and scaling your social media management services.

books.title: Social Media Content Creation
books.description: Master the art of creating engaging social media content. From photography to video editing, this book covers the full content creation workflow.
books.author: SavvyPro Team

chapters.title: Photography Basics
chapters.body: Learn to take great photos with any camera. We cover lighting, composition, and editing techniques that make your content stand out.

chapters.title: Video Creation
chapters.body: Short-form video is the dominant format on social media. Learn to script, shoot, and edit videos that capture attention and drive engagement.

chapters.title: Design Fundamentals
chapters.body: Great design makes your content more shareable. This chapter covers color theory, typography, and layout principles for non-designers.

chapters.title: Content Planning
chapters.body: Never run out of content ideas again. Learn to build a content calendar, batch produce content, and maintain a consistent posting schedule.

chapters.title: Tools & Resources
chapters.body: The best tools for content creators. From editing apps to scheduling platforms, we cover the complete toolkit for efficient content production.

books.title: Infopreneur Roadmap
books.description: Turn your knowledge into a profitable information product business. From idea validation to course launch, this book covers the complete infopreneur journey.
books.author: SavvyPro Team

chapters.title: Finding Your Expertise
chapters.body: Everyone has knowledge worth sharing. This chapter helps you identify your unique expertise and package it into a marketable information product.

chapters.title: Product Creation
chapters.body: From ebooks to courses to memberships, learn to create information products that deliver real value to your audience.

chapters.title: Sales Funnels
chapters.body: Build a funnel that converts. Learn to create landing pages, email sequences, and sales pages that turn visitors into customers.

chapters.title: Traffic Generation
chapters.body: No product succeeds without traffic. We cover organic and paid strategies for driving qualified visitors to your offers.

chapters.title: Scaling Your Business
chapters.body: Take your infopreneur business to the next level. This chapter covers team building, product expansion, and systems for sustainable growth.

books.title: Start Where You Are
books.description: A practical guide to starting your business journey from wherever you are right now. No prerequisites, no fancy equipment needed - just actionable steps to move forward.
books.author: SavvyPro Team

chapters.title: Mindset Shifts
chapters.body: The biggest barrier to starting is often mental. Learn to reframe your thinking and overcome the limiting beliefs that hold you back.

chapters.title: Goal Setting
chapters.body: Set goals that actually matter. This chapter covers SMART goals, quarterly planning, and tracking progress toward your business objectives.

chapters.title: Action Planning
chapters.body: Turn goals into action. Learn to break big projects into manageable tasks and create a weekly execution plan.

chapters.title: Overcoming Obstacles
chapters.body: Every business journey faces challenges. Learn to anticipate problems and build resilience for the inevitable setbacks.

chapters.title: Building Momentum
chapters.body: Small wins create big results. This chapter covers habits, routines, and systems that keep you moving forward consistently.

chapters.title: Resources & Tools
chapters.body: The essential tools for starting a business. From domain registration to accounting software, we cover the complete starter toolkit.

chapters.title: Your First Customers
chapters.body: Getting your first paying customers is the biggest milestone. Learn to validate your offer and find your first 10 customers.

chapters.title: Pricing Your Services
chapters.body: Charge what you're worth. This chapter covers pricing strategies, package creation, and negotiating with clients.

chapters.title: Marketing Basics
chapters.body: Get your business in front of the right people. Learn the fundamentals of content marketing, social media, and email marketing.

chapters.title: Scaling Sustainably
chapters.body: Grow without burning out. This chapter covers sustainable growth strategies, team building, and work-life balance for entrepreneurs.
